/-! ## The theorems -/

/-- **PCP theorem, gap form.** For a fixed fraction `num / den > 0`, every NP language has a
polynomial-time gap reduction to 3-SAT with gap `num / den`. -/
theorem pcp_gap : ∃ num den : Nat, 0 < num ∧
    ∀ L : Language, InNP L → ∃ g : Word → SAT.CNF, GapReduction num den L g := by
  sorry

/-- **PCP theorem, verifier form.** `NP = PCP(O(log n), O(1))`: a language is in NP iff it has a
probabilistically checkable proof system with `c * log n` random bits and `q` queries. -/
theorem pcp_theorem (L : Language) : InNP L ↔ ∃ c q, InPCP c q L := by
  sorry

/-- The problems of the syntactic class MaxSNP₀ are in NPO: their solutions (structures of the
solution signature on the universe of the instance) are polynomially bounded, and feasibility
and value are computed by one polynomial-time function. -/
theorem npo_maxSNP0 (ga sa : List Nat) (k : Nat) (φ : QF) : NPO (maxSNP0 ga sa k φ) := by
  sorry

/-- MaxSNP-hard problems cannot be approximated within every ratio `1 + 1 / (k + 1)` in
polynomial time (even by a separate algorithm for each `k`) unless `P = NP`. -/
theorem maxSNPHard_no_ptas {P : OptProblem} (hP : MaxSNPHard P)
    (h : ∀ k, P.ApproximableWithin (k + 2) (k + 1)) : PEqNP := by
  sorry

/-- MaxSNP-hard problems have no polynomial-time approximation scheme unless `P = NP`. -/
theorem maxSNPHard_not_hasPTAS {P : OptProblem} (hP : MaxSNPHard P) (h : P.HasPTAS) :
    PEqNP := by
  sorry

/-- MAX-3-SAT is MaxSNP-complete. -/
theorem max3SAT_maxSNPComplete : MaxSNPComplete max3SAT := by
  sorry

/-- 3-OCCURRENCE MAX-3-SAT is MaxSNP-complete. -/
theorem max3SAT3_maxSNPComplete : MaxSNPComplete max3SAT3 := by
  sorry

/-- MAX-3-SAT is APX-complete. -/
theorem max3SAT_apxComplete : APXComplete max3SAT := by
  sorry

/-- 3-OCCURRENCE MAX-3-SAT is APX-complete. -/
theorem max3SAT3_apxComplete : APXComplete max3SAT3 := by
  sorry

end Complexity
